expressions.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Islamabad, October 3, 1998, p.129) prints the masthead, F. No. 2(2)/97-Pub. ('The following Orders made by the President on the 2nd October, 1998') and 'PRESIDENT'S ORDER No. 1 OF 1998 AN ORDER' with its preamble; p2 (p.130) Article 1 'This Order may be called the Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998' and Article 2 'Salary' (1)-(2) (block 1565136). President's Order No. 2 of 1998 (amending the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997) follows and is cut off in its Article 3 at the end of this copy: set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
